tables_dir.description: Base directory containing the rainbow tables. Corresponds to the -d option.

tables.description: List of table names and indices to use. Each sub-list represents a table set separated by colons in the final config. For example, ['xp_free_fast', '0', '3'] results in 'xp_free_fast,0,3'. To specify multiple table sets, add more sub-lists: [['xp_free_fast', '0', '3'], ['vista_free']]. Corresponds to the -t option.

input_file.description: Path to the file containing hashes in pwdump or session format. Corresponds to the -f option.

output_file.description: Path to write the cracking output in pwdump format. Corresponds to the -o option.

log_file.description: Path to log all output. Corresponds to the -l option.

threads.description: Number of threads to use for cracking. Corresponds to the -n option.

disable_bruteforce.description: If true, disables bruteforce mode (-b). If false, enables it (-B, which is the default). Corresponds to -b/-B options.

hide_usernames.description: If true, hides usernames (-i). If false, shows them (-I, which is the default). Corresponds to -i/-I options.

no_empty_passwords.description: If true, does not display empty passwords (-e). Corresponds to -e option.

quiet.description: If true, enables quiet mode (-q). Corresponds to -q option.

verbose.description: If true, enables verbose mode (-v). Corresponds to -v option.

debug.description: If true, displays debugging information (-D). Corresponds to -D option.

disable_audit_mode.description: If true, disables audit mode (-a). If false, enables it (-A). Corresponds to -a/-A options.

disable_session_saving.description: If true, disables session auto-saving (-s). Corresponds to -s option.

session_file.description: Path to the session file for automatically saving search progress. Corresponds to the -S option.

show_statistics.description: If true, displays statistics when cracking ends (-u). Corresponds to -u option.

export_csv.description: If true, exports data in CSV format to the file specified by -o (-x). Corresponds to -x option.
